sample_rule: lowest SHA256(case_id), independent of model outputs
generation_order: all baseline cases, then all treatment cases, to avoid repeated model reloads

cases.question: Find the average number of long-shot done by Ahmed Samir Farag.

baseline.sql: SELECT AVG(player_Attributes.long_shots) FROM Player_Attributes INNER JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

treatment.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.player_api_id) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

cases.question: Which year has the most number of races?

baseline.sql:
SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS total_races
FROM races
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY total_races DESC
LIMIT 1;

treatment.sql: SELECT YEAR FROM races GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Among all chemical compounds identified in the database, what percent of compounds form a triple-bond.

baseline.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN m.molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id), 0) AS percent_triple_bond FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id;

treatment.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bond

cases.question: Calculate the total amount spent on speaker gifts and list the name of the event they were spent on.

baseline.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts';

treatment.sql: SELECT SUM(T1.spent) AS total_amount_spent, T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Speaker Gifts'

cases.question: List out of players whose preferred foot is left.

baseline.sql:
SELECT Player.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left';

treatment.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.preferred_foot = 'left'

cases.question: What is the display name of the user who acquired the first Autobiographer badge?

baseline.sql:
SELECT UserDisplayName 
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
  AND (b.Date, UserId) = (
    SELECT MIN(b1.Date), b1.UserId 
    FROM badges b1 
    WHERE b1.Name = 'Autobiographer'
  );

treatment.sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Name = 'Autobiographer' ORDER BY T2.Date LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average number of bonds the atoms with the element iodine have?

baseline.sql:
SELECT AVG(1) AS average_bonds 
FROM atom 
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id 
WHERE atom.element = 'I' 
GROUP BY atom.atom_id;

treatment.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.atom_id) AS avg_bonds FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'i'

cases.question: How many black border cards are only available on mtgo?

baseline.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE borderColor = 'black' 
  AND availability = 'mtgo';

treatment.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'black' AND availability = 'mtgo';

cases.question: Indicate the top source of funds received in September 2019 based on their amount.

baseline.sql:
SELECT source 
FROM income 
WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30' 
ORDER BY amount DESC 
LIMIT 1;

treatment.sql: SELECT source FROM income WHERE date_received LIKE '2019-09%' ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What are the name of badge that users who have the highest reputation obtained?

baseline.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
ORDER BY u.Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;

treatment.sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM badges AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users )

cases.question: Which kind of credit card does client number 9 possess?

baseline.sql:
SELECT card.type
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.card_id
WHERE client.client_id = 9;

treatment.sql: SELECT T1.type FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.card_id = T2.disp_id WHERE T2.client_id = 9

cases.question: What is the ratio between students majored in finance and physics?

baseline.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN major.major_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
       NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN major.major_name = 'Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

treatment.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.major_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.major_name = 'Physics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
